create_quantlinear_layer: create a QuantLinear layer with 4-bit quantization for a given input and output feature size
pack_weights_248_bits: pack linear layer weights into 2, 4, or 8-bit quantized format using pack_248_bits method
pack_weights_3bits: pack linear layer weights into 3-bit quantized format using pack_3bits method
run_quantized_forward: run a forward pass through a QuantLinear layer to compute quantized output from input tensor
get_wf_3bits_tensor: get or create a device-specific 3-bit weight format tensor for quantized unpacking operations
